 ORDER

This is the first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR No.283/2022 registered at Police Station Kotwali District Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Section 3 read with Section 4, 5(1) read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
As per prosecution case, it is alleged that the applicant has abducted the minor girl and forcefully committed sexual assault with her and thereafter she became pregnant.
She was recovered and she narrated the entire incident to her parents.

On the basis of the complaint made by the prosecutrix,

sentences.text: the aforesaid offence came to be registered against the present applicant.
It is submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence in any manner.
It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since 16.03.2023 i.e. more than 2 months.
As per 164 statement, the prosecutrix is a consenting party.
The prosecutrix herself gone with the present applicant to Panna and then Haryana and to some other places.
It is submitted that the MLC doctor has not found any injury on the body of the prosecutrix.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his bail application.
In view of the aforesaid, he prays for grant of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State vehemently opposed the application stating that there is active participation of the present applicant in commission of offence.
He has prayed for dismissal of the application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case and in view of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.,
this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed .

The applicant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified copy as per rules.
